statement: The membership lifecycle controller is reduced to its live decision layer: the intent/drain delegates (submitJoinIntent at join start, submitDrainIntent on SIGTERM driving bootstrapAPI.markDraining) are preserved and renamed accordingly, while the unconsumed per-member state machine and transition history (zero consumers) and the currently-unreachable invalid-removal transition are removed.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

Keep the live intent/drain delegates (submitJoinIntent, submitDrainIntent -> bootstrapAPI.markDraining); the reframe confirmed these are NOT shadow. Only the unconsumed state machine and transition history are removed.
This is a dead-code removal; no runtime decision changes. Proof is that the intent/drain behavior tests stay green and the removed surface had zero production consumers.
A guard must fail if the unconsumed state machine or transition history is reintroduced without a consumer.
